enriched_activities.desc: Remains lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to shoulders. Moves right arm under pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Bends left leg. Snores lightly. Turns onto back. Stretches arms above head. Lowers arms. Remains still. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket over head. Remains still.

Walks to bathroom. Opens door. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands with soap. Dries hands. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Washes face. Dries face. Picks up comb. Combs hair. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out cereal. Takes out bowl. Takes out spoon. Closes cupboard. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Sits at table. Eats cereal. Drinks milk. Stands up. Rinses bowl and spoon. Places in drying rack. Wipes table.

Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Places laptop in bag. Zips bag. Picks up phone. Unplugs charger. Places phone in pocket. Picks up keys. Places keys in bag. Picks up bag.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits down. Looks out window. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to train station. Taps card. Boards train. Sits down. Stands up. Exits train. Walks to university.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education classes at Monash University
enriched_activities.desc: Enters classroom. Sits at desk. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Opens notebook. Writes notes. Listens to lecturer. Raises hand. Asks question. Writes more notes. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Types notes. Closes laptop. Packs notebook and pen. Stands up. Exits classroom.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich. Selects apple. Selects bottle of water. Pays at cashier. Walks to table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Eats apple. Drinks water. Clears tray. Walks to library. Sits at table. Opens laptop. Checks email.

Enters classroom. Sits at desk. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Opens notebook. Writes notes. Listens to lecturer. Participates in discussion. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Types notes. Closes laptop. Packs materials. Stands up. Exits classroom.

Enters library. Finds empty desk. Sits down. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Connects to Wi-Fi. Opens browser. Searches for articles. Reads articles. Takes notes. Checks phone. Puts phone away. Continues reading. Closes laptop. Packs bag. Stands up. Exits library.

Walks to train station. Taps card. Boards train. Sits down. Looks out window. Stands up. Exits train. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits down. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks home.

Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot. Takes out knife. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Cuts vegetables. Places vegetables in pot. Adds water. Turns off stove. Scoops food into bowl. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Rinses bowl. Places in sink.

Enters workplace. Clocks in. Puts on apron. Walks to counter. Greets customer. Takes order. Enters order into register. Accepts payment. Gives change. Prepares food. Serves food. Cleans table. Wipes counter. Restocks supplies. Takes order from next customer. Processes payment. Cleans table again. Clocks out. Removes apron. Exits workplace.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Sits down. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooling down with fan/AC and relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on air conditioner. Turns on fan. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Turns off fan. Turns off air conditioner. Stands up. Walks out of living room.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rubs body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up phone. Plug in charger. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes slowly. Remains still. Falls asleep.
